notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Recently someone reached out to me asking to remove their highscore from the top spot since they had used cheating tools to get there. 

I really appreciated them reaching out so this update adds an option under the settings menu to disable auto submitting highscores for anyone who wishes to do something similar.

Whilst I'm here might as well make my stance on this public. I have absolutely nothing against people using cheating tools. So long as it doesn't impact others in [i]any[/i] way, then no harm done!

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to a suggestion/request from YellowberryHN I have added a colour blind mode which features an adjustable contrast slider.

Hopefuly its helpful and let me know if not!
